title: Investigating Anthropometric Fidelity in SAM 3D Body
abstract: arXiv:2601.06035v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The release of SAM 3D Body is a recent development in human mesh recovery, demonstrating improved performance in producing clean, topologically coherent meshes from single images. By leveraging the Momentum Human Rig (MHR), it achieves robustness to occlusion and diverse poses. However, our evaluation reveals a specific and consistent limitation: the model struggles to reconstruct detailed anthropometric deviations, particularly in populations exhibiting distinctive morphological alterations such as geriatric muscle atrophy, scoliosis, or pregnancy, even when these features are prominent in the input image. In this paper, we investigate this phenomenon not as a failure of the model's capacity, but as a byproduct of the "perception-distortion trade-off". translated_title: 探究 SAM 3D Body 中的人体测量学保真度
translated_abstract: SAM 3D Body 的发布是人体网格恢复领域的最新进展，展示了其从单张图像生成干净、拓扑连贯网格方面的性能提升。通过利用动量人体骨架，该模型对遮挡和多样化姿态表现出鲁棒性。然而，我们的评估揭示了一个具体且一致的局限性：该模型难以重建细节化的人体测量学偏差，尤其是在表现出显著形态学改变的人群中，例如老年性肌肉萎缩、脊柱侧弯或怀孕，即使这些特征在输入图像中十分明显。在本文中，我们并非将这一现象视为模型能力的失败，而是将其作为“感知-失真权衡”的副产品加以研究。我们认为，架构上对低维参数化 MHR 表示的依赖，结合语义不变的调节机制（DINOv3）以及基于标注的对齐，造……
tldr: 本文发现 SAM 3D Body 难以重建特殊体型人群（如肌肉萎缩、脊柱侧弯、怀孕）的人体测量细节，并将其归因于“感知-失真权衡”与低维参数化 MHR 表示等架构设计带来的系统性偏差，而非模型能力不足。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that SAM 3D Body's failure to reconstruct detailed anthropometric deviations (e.g., muscle atrophy, scoliosis, pregnancy) stems not from model capacity but as a byproduct of the perception-distortion trade-off induced by its low-dimensional MHR representation, semantic-invariant conditioning, and annotation-based alignment.
